findings.location: html: aya ya kwanza chini ya “Tohara ya kiroho”, sentensi ya kwanza
findings.source_quote: Were I to love something besides God, I should not love God with my whole heart.
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha sentensi hiyo iwe: “Kama ningependa kitu kingine chochote mbali na Mungu, singempenda Mungu kwa moyo wangu wote.”
findings.translation_quote: Kama ningependa kitu kingine zaidi ya Mungu, singempenda Mungu kwa moyo wangu wote.
